instruction: The SQLite database 'Database for tasks.sqlite3' in the current directory has tables: CATEGORY(WARE, CLASS) - which category (CLASS) a ware belongs to (a ware may belong to several categories); MANUFACTURER(BILL_ID, COMPANY) - bills of materials and the companies owning them; MATERIAL(BILL_ID, WARE, AMOUNT) - materials used by a bill; PRODUCT(BILL_ID, WARE, AMOUNT, PRICE) - wares produced by a bill, with amount and price. A bill may produce several wares. Get the average price and the variance of the price of Meat. Write avg;var on one line. The variance is the population variance (the average of squared deviations from the mean). Both values rounded to one decimal point. Compute the answer with bash (sqlite3 and/or python3). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
